notes: German parent bank (Deutsche Bank Aktiengesellschaft). Form-text on Jared and Ivanka filings says 'Deutsche Bank' — per Fork F §4 Decision Q4, that text resolves to the parent (Deutsche Bank AG) rather than the U.S. subsidiary DBTCA (cp_entity_0132). The parent vs. subsidiary distinction is preserved; each row's edge targets the entity whose form-name matches that row's transcription. A subsidiary edge from Deutsche Bank AG to DBTCA was authorized in §4 Decision Q4 but deferred for Fork F: the filings don't disclose the value bracket of the parent-subsidiary stake (DBAG owns DBTCA via external corporate structure, not via any OGE 278 disclosure), so the edge can't be cleanly written under the existing Convention 4 pattern. Captured in notes pending a fork that adds external-source registry edges.
